exact_prompt: Create a transparent 1-column x 5-row sprite atlas. Each row is a distinct pose-specific FRONT orthographic view of the same muscular dark-haired male adventurer from the corresponding source panel, in row order: base idle, idle2, walk1, walk2, walk3. The last panel on the reference sheet is an approved head-on FRONT style/camera example (attack pose only); use it as camera/style guidance, NOT its pose. For every row, rotate camera to true head-on FRONT looking along the character's fixed world-Y facing direction. Show centered symmetrical front torso and both eyes; the backpack sits behind the shoulders and is mostly occluded. Preserve the exact source's red-and-white shorts, barefoot costume, skin/hair, proportions, and the specific different arm/leg step phase of each row. Do not copy one standing pose into all rows. Keep each row upright full body, no kick, no weapon, no held objects, no shadows or floor. Strict orthographic 2D pixel-art matching source, no perspective/isometric. Equal-height row cells with generous vertical gutters, full silhouette uncut, transparent background, no labels or text.
